description: Deterministic compound growth of monthly contributions (plus an optional starting sum) at a fixed annual return. Returns contributions, gains and total by year, and a compoundsim.app url. Use simulate_portfolio for the range of outcomes of real assets.

annual_return_pct.description: Effective annual return (CAGR), applied as the equivalent monthly rate.

currency.description: Currency of every amount, in and out. In a currency other than USD the paths carry its exchange-rate swings against the dollar (trend removed). Defaults to the language's currency.

inflation_percent.description: Annual inflation. When given, every amount out is in today's money at this rate; omitted, amounts are nominal.

language.description: Language of the page the returned url opens; match the user's language.

monthly.description: Amount invested at the end of every month.

name: simulate_fixed_rate
title: Compound interest at a fixed rate
